latest_release.name: v0.21.37 🍰
latest_release.body:
## 🍰 Highlights

- **TV apps on LG webOS and Samsung Tizen**: new optional provider plugins `@agent-device/webos` (#4098) and `@agent-device/tizen` (#4168) drive web apps on TVs. They support `open`, `snapshot`, remote keys, pointer, text, scroll, `screenshot` and `logs`.
- **Limrun iOS runs on the shared XCTest runner** (#4224, #4182). It uses the same snapshot and interaction paths as a local Simulator. Local app installs sync to the instance (#4225), and boot and shutdown map to instance leases (#4275).
- **Parallel web sessions** (#4191): each web session is its own device, so sessions with different `--session` names run side by side on one host. Web device ids now include the session (`agent-browser-chrome:session:...`).
- **Pin a workspace to a device** (#4384) with `devicePin` in `agent-device.json`. Commands select within the pin, and conflicting selectors fail with `device_pin_conflict`.
- **Safer presses on iOS**: `back` is now a verified left-edge swipe (#4460). A synthesized gesture that may already have run is never repeated (#4474). Press and click wait for a moving target within the request's deadline and cancellation (#4461).
- **Deterministic iOS screenshots**: `screenshot --screen-mask black` masks the simulator outline for stable visual baselines (#4206), and `--capture-backend runner` selects the XCTest runner capture (#4184).
- **More accurate snapshots**: iOS 27 system toolbars no longer cover their own controls (#4494). Android alert titles and messages stay in `snapshot -i` (#4493). Empty text fields show their placeholder (#4467). Zero-area iOS nodes are marked unmeasured and point at `scroll --until` (#4495).
- **macOS context menus** open on a native secondary click (#3962).
- **Hardening from the November audit** across the daemon, remote transport, replay, capture and providers (#4355, #4358, #4360, #4362, #4363, #4366 and more).

## Breaking changes (MCP)

- **Tool results are text by default** (#4466). `agent-device mcp` returns compact text, with no output schemas and no `structuredContent`. To get the previous structured results and output schemas, start the server with `agent-device mcp --structured`. AI SDK tools keep their structured results.
- **UI targets are top-level fields** (#4459). `press`, `click`, `fill`, `longpress` and `hover` take `ref` (with an optional `label`), `selector`, or `x` + `y`. `get` takes `ref` or `selector`. The nested `target: { kind, ... }` object is rejected with a message that shows the new form. This also applies to `batch` steps, so update saved `batch --steps` files and `client.batch.run` steps. The typed `client.interactions.*` API is unchanged.
  ```
  press {"ref":"@e6"}    click {"selector":"id=\"home/products\""}    press {"x":201,"y":160}
  ```
- **Operator-only inputs left the tool schemas** (#4468). `tenant`, `runId`, `leaseId` and `androidDeviceAllowlist` are refused as tool input in MCP and AI SDK tools. Set them in the server environment (`AGENT_DEVICE_TENANT`, `AGENT_DEVICE_RUN_ID`, `AGENT_DEVICE_LEASE_ID`) or in config. `tools/list` shrank from 268 KB to 216 KB, and every input schema is now 5 KB or less.
- **Stricter server arguments and session lock** (#4355). `agent-device mcp` accepts only `--structured`, `--help` and `--version`. Configure the server with `AGENT_DEVICE_*` variables or `AGENT_DEVICE_CONFIG`. The session lock now comes only from the serving process (`AGENT_DEVICE_SESSION`, `AGENT_DEVICE_SESSION_LOCK`, `AGENT_DEVICE_PLATFORM`), never from tool input. The stdio server also no longer stalls on blank or malformed lines, keeps answering `ping` and `tools/list` during a call, and cancels the daemon request on `notifications/cancelled`.

## What's Changed
* feat(provider-webos): add LG webOS TV provider plugin by @alimek in https://github.com/callstack/agent-device/pull/4098
* fix(ios): report an unreadable system prompt as ALERT_UNRESOLVED, not absence by @thymikee in https://github.com/callstack/agent-device/pull/4149
